reason: Although framed as a move/refactor, this PR relocates foundational logical planner operators (`DataSource`, `TableScan`, `IndexScan`, `TiKVGather`) and edits a very broad set of core planner code paths: plan building, rule rewrites, task selection, stats, cascades, pattern matching, point get, and index/partition logic. That is central optimizer infrastructure with high blast radius, and package-boundary refactors here can easily hide semantic regressions or incorrect method/registration behavior. This is important and risky enough to justify a focused deep review for High/Blocker planner issues.
